description: Quick KYA Trust Score for any AI agent wallet. Returns score (0-100), tier, and sanctions status. Paid via x402 USDC.

_signals.network_names: Arbitrum, Base, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon, SKALE Base
_signals.x_guidance:
AsterPay is an API for AI agents that provides trust scoring, market data, AI tools, crypto analytics, and fiat settlement.

FREE endpoints (no payment):
- GET /v1/agent/trust-score/{address} — Score any agent 0-100
- GET /v1/agent/verify/{address} — ERC-8004 identity check
- GET /v1/settlement/estimate?amount={usdc} — EUR settlement estimate
- GET /v1/agent/discovery — Full API discovery
- GET /v2/x402/market/rates — Market rates
- GET /v1/market/price/{symbol} — Real-time crypto price (also /ohlcv, /trending)
- POST /v1/ai/summarize — Text summarization (also /sentiment, /translate, /fact-check)
- GET /v1/crypto/whale-alerts — Recent whale movements

PAID endpoints (x402 or MPP, USDC on Base):
- GET /v1/agent/deep-analysis/{address} — $0.01 — Deep behavioral analysis
- GET /v1/crypto/token-analysis/{address} — $0.10 — Token security analysis
- GET /v1/crypto/wallet-score/{address} — $0.05 — Wallet reputation score
- POST /v1/ai/code-review — $0.05 — Code security & quality analysis
- GET /v2/x402/crypto/prices — $0.005 — Aggregated price feed

Payment: Send USDC on Base to the address in the 402 challenge. Both x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) and MPP (Authorization: Payment header) are accepted.
Settlement: After payment, AsterPay can settle USDC to EUR via SEPA Instant in under 10 seconds.
